title: Basic Commands [mkdir and touch]
description:
# mkdir and touch
## mkdir
---
`mkdir` stands for _make directory_.
You use it via `mkdir PATH`, and it will create a directory at the end of PATH if it doesn't exist already, however if there are multiple non-existent dirs, it will error. To do this, run it with -p, which will create all missing directorys on this path.
---
## touch
---
`touch` creates a file at the end of path, so `touch ~/NON_EXISTANT_FILE.txt` will create a file at that path. Touch errors if the file already exists or the path is invalid.
---
